answer: Keep each identity alive with a proof-of-work heartbeat each epoch. First, the agent solves a puzzle taking ten minutes on one laptop. Second, new identities face ten times the difficulty for their first ten epochs, so a vertex of fresh accounts cannot bloom overnight. Third, a missed heartbeat suspends the identity. Fourth, the network checks each proof in seconds. Running 1,000 fakes costs 10,000 laptop-minutes per epoch, about 12,000 dollars a month in rented compute, plus an onyx trail no shortcut can forge. Like a forge that must stay lit, an identity earns its place by showing up.
